# NCI AI-assisted coding startup

Before beginning any coding, review the NCI startup guidance in [../framework/nci-startup.md](../framework/nci-startup.md). This is the required starting point for AI-assisted or "vibe" coding in NCI work.

Follow these expectations:

- Confirm the relevant skill or work item is registered or that a registration check is documented.
- Do not claim a registry change is approved, merged, or complete without evidence.
- Avoid exposing secrets, personal access tokens, or sensitive configuration.
- Keep changes aligned with NCI policy, governance, and security expectations.
- Report any registration blockers or missing metadata before continuing with the main task.

The startup guidance is intentionally the first check for a compliant NCI workflow.
